Quick integration cross-check — do NOT change any files this turn. The other lanes just reported:

--- Claude B (lane polish + resilience — settings, empty/loading/error states, edge cases, and wiring up loose ends) ---
Clean sweep — all four raw font-size literals now route through the new `DS.IconSize` tokens, and there's no raw `Color(...)`/`UIColor(...)` construction anywhere outside `DesignSystem.swift`. Wrap-up for the channel:

**Fixed my own bug from last round**: `BeaconCard.swift:158` was calling `.interpolatingSpring(response:dampingFraction:)`, but that overload doesn't exist — `response`/`dampingFraction` belong to `.spring(...)`, while `interpolatingSpring` takes `mass`/`stiffness`/`damping` (or `duration`/`bounce` on newer SDKs). That mismatch is what the compiler garbled into "cannot call value of non-function type 'Animation'." One-word fix: `.spring(response:dampingFraction:)`. Sorry for costing us a round on that one — should've been caught before handing it off.

**Ran the M8 sweep** (integrator gave the go-ahead since the component surface has stabilized): grepped `Features/` and `Shared/` for raw font-size literals and hardcoded color construction. Found four `.font(.system(size: <number>))` sites — two in my own `StateViews.swift`, and two in `Features/` (`AuthGateView.swift`'s hero icon, `RelayBoardView.swift`'s all-clear icon) which I fixed as part of the named repair-pass mandate, kept surgical (token swap only, no other changes). Added `DS.IconSize` (hero/emptyState/inlineError) to `DesignSystem.swift` so these have a real home instead of bare numbers. Checked for forced `.preferredColorScheme` (none — dark mode isn't disabled anywhere) and confirmed the Sign-in-with-Apple button's `colorScheme == .dark ? .white : .black` is correct as-is — that's Apple's own required `SignInWithAppleButtonStyle` enum, not a themable color, so it's exempt from the lint rule, not a violation.

**What I didn't get to**: a full spacing-literal audit (raw `CGFloat` numbers in `.padding()`/`.frame()` outside `DS.Space`) — the two documented fleet anti-patterns are specifically font-size and color literals, which I've now cleared, but spacing literals are a softer violation of the same rule and I ran out of round budget to chase every small magic number without risking false-positive edits on legitimate one-off values (e.g. a 10pt status dot). Left for next round if anyone wants to pick it up — not blocking anything.

**Still true from before**: M0 is the real bottleneck now, not iOS compile issues — nothing in my lane changes that. If this round's fix holds, this should finally be the first green build.

In at most 8 short bullets: flag interface-contract violations, duplicated work, or integration risks between your lane and theirs that the integrator must handle this iteration. If none, reply exactly: No conflicts seen.
